records.finding: The exact legal entity Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC is both (a) named on Bitnomial's current clearing-member list and (b) identified by Ripple's official FCM disclosure as a registered FCM and SEC/FINRA broker-dealer. Ripple states Hidden Road is now Ripple Prime. This is a direct institutional/clearing-network connection, not merely a broad brand association. It creates a plausible XRP collateral path if the FCM has filed the required Letter 26-05 notice and satisfies conditions; no public evidence of its reliance date, XRP collateral deposits or utilization was found. Coinbase Financial Markets remains the Letter 26-05 requestor; its requestor status does not establish its own XRP use or a Bitnomial clearing relationship.
records.coinbase_strategy: Reuters Q3 2026 reports prediction markets exceeded $200M annualized run-rate revenue; prediction markets plus derivatives represented about 25% of transaction revenue; subscription/services about 49% of net revenue. This supports Coinbase's multi-product diversification thesis, while transaction revenue still fell 43% year-over-year and the annualized prediction figure is not recognized quarterly revenue or XRP-specific activity.
